title: One Idea, Eleven Definitions
subtitle: 概念与观念 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 概念与观念（语言与思维·概念与范畴）
meta: 主题语境：概念与观念（语言与思维·概念与范畴）　|　核心词汇：concept　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 concept 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my teacher ① explained a concept that no textbook in the school defined, and she said the explaining was the whole of the lesson. The ② concept, meaning the idea and not the word, took eleven minutes and stayed unexplained; concept, she said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how many definitions it survives.

Every ③ concept in that chapter had the same example, and the ④ concept at the end, meaning the one she kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever argued about twice. Concept, my mother said, is nine parts example and one part somebody willing to define; my teacher said the defining is the part that fills the board.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the concept was the whole of the design, meaning the plan and not the idea. The ⑥ concept, meaning the plan and not any of that, is the only thing in a design that everybody praises and nobody draws; concept, he said, is either something you explain or the only word that means both an idea and a plan. She said the plan is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ concept had become a line in a syllabus, and the syllabus had become an argument about the example. The ⑧ concept of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in February, was one lesson and thirty years of defining; concept, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to argue. He said the arguing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ concept I remember is the one at the end, which she explained in 1975 and is still described as the least defined in the school. A ⑩ concept, my mother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being argued about; every concept, she said, is a plan that has agreed to look like an idea. She said the plan was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 概念（指那个观念本身，与那个词相对）
C. 固定搭配：explain a concept 讲解一个概念
D. n. 概念（指那一章里每一个）
E. n. 概念（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 构想；方案（指设计里的总体方案）
G. n. 概念（指教学大纲里提到的那一个）
H. n. 理念；构想（抽象总称）

items.q: explained a concept that no textbook in the school defined
The concept, meaning the idea and not the word
the concept was the whole of the design
the concept had become a line in a syllabus
The concept of the whole thing
A concept, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: explain a concept 意为“讲解一个概念”，1961 年老师讲解了一个全校课本都没下定义的概念。
concept 意为“概念”，指那个观念本身而不是那个词，它讲了十一分钟，并且一直没有被讲透。
concept 指那一章里每一个概念，每一个都用同一个例子。
concept 指末尾那一个（她留给考试的那一个），是唯一有人争论过两次的。
concept 意为“构想、方案”，叔叔说这个构想就是那件设计作品的全部，指的是总体方案而不是那个观念。
concept 为另一个义项，指设计里的总体方案而不是那个观念，是设计里人人称赞、却无人画出的东西。
concept 意为“概念”，指教学大纲里提到的那一个，到 1969 年这个概念成了大纲里的一行。
concept 意为“理念、构想”，老师二月写道，整件事的理念是一堂课三十年的下定义。
concept 意为“概念、观念”，我记得的是末尾那一个，她 1975 年讲过，至今仍被说成全校最没被讲透的。
concept 为抽象总称，母亲说一个概念是唯一会因为被争论而变好的东西。
